name: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

meta.wiki: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

summary: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur is a Horde military task issued by Karang Amakkar at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. To bypass the heavily defended night elf stronghold of Astranaar, the Horde aims to clear a northern passage obstructed by the hostile Thistlefur tribe. By thinning the ranks of Thistlefur Village, Horde champions help secure vital overland routes across the disputed forest.

sections.title: Bypassing the Sentinels
sections.body: The main road running east-west through central Ashenvale is dominated by Astranaar, the fortified heart of night elf resistance in the forest. Moving troops, lumber shipments, and supply trains past Astranaar's watchful sentinels invites constant ambushes and catastrophic losses. For the commanders at Splintertree Post, finding an alternate route is not merely convenient—it is an operational necessity if the Horde hopes to maintain a foothold in the canopy.

sections.title: The Thistlefur Obstacle
sections.body: North of the central road lies Thistlefur Village, nestled in the rocky ridges and dens of Ashenvale. While this northern trail would allow Horde forces to move freely around Astranaar, the Thistlefur furbolgs control the territory with fierce aggression. Corrupted and territorial, the tribe attacks any outsiders who step near their dens. Karang Amakkar demands preemptive strikes against the tribe, clearing out their warriors so the Horde can establish a secure alternate passage.

faq.q: Why does Karang Amakkar want the Thistlefur furbolgs killed?
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs occupy a critical northern pass connecting Horde positions without needing to march directly past the night elf settlement of Astranaar. Clearing out the furbolgs opens up a safer expansion route for Horde troops and supply lines.

Thistlefur Village is situated in northern Ashenvale, northwest of Astranaar and west of Splintertree Post. The village is nestled against the foothills, featuring hollowed dens, winding paths, and a dense furbolg population.

Karang Amakkar is an orc officer stationed in Ashenvale serving the Horde war effort. He focuses on securing strategic movement corridors and subduing local threats that hinder Horde expansion against the Alliance.

faq.q: Why can't the Horde just use the main road?
faq.answer: The central highway of Ashenvale passes right alongside Astranaar, a heavily fortified night elf bastion. Marching supply wagons and reinforcements within bowshot of night elf sentinels leads to heavy casualties and choked logistical routes.

faq.q: Why are the Thistlefur furbolgs so hostile?
faq.answer: Like many furbolg tribes across Kalimdor following the Third War, the Thistlefur have fallen to foul demonic corruption lingering in the woods. Their minds twisted by rage and madness, they violently butcher any travelers who stray into their territory.

faq.q: What happens after clearing the furbolgs?
aliases: next quest after between a rock
faq.answer: Thinning the Thistlefur provides temporary breathing room, but deeper threats remain among the local tribes. Karang Amakkar and other Horde scouts continue directing efforts to destabilize other hostile enclaves, including the Foulweald tribe deeper in the forest.

angles.text: Controlling the passage through northern Ashenvale is essential for linking front-line outposts and securing timber operations without losing caravans to night elf archers.
Ashenvale's conquest requires iron discipline and clear supply lines; clearing violent beast-men out of strategic terrain is standard warfare for the warchief's vanguard.
The Horde's efforts to circumvent Astranaar threaten to unravel the Sentinels' defensive perimeter, endangering northern sacred sites from aggressive logging parties.
